1.3. Ndondomeko iyi yakonzedwa motsatira Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation, "GDPR"). Iyenera kuwerengedwa pamodzi ndi Migwirizano Yogwiritsa Ntchito ndi Ndondomeko ya Makeke.

2.1. Deta ya akaunti: adilesi ya imelo ndi mawu achinsinsi obisika (hashed). Ngati musankha "Lowani ndi Google", timalandira dzina lanu, adilesi ya imelo ndi chithunzi chanu kuchokera ku akaunti yanu ya Google.

2.2. Deta yolipira: dongosolo la kulembetsa ndi momwe lilili, tsatanetsatane wa ma invoice ndi mbiri yolipira. Malipiro onse a kirediti kadi amakonzedwa mwachindunji ndi wopereka malipiro otetezeka Stripe; Wopereka sasunga nambala zonse za kirediti kadi.

2.3. Deta yolumikizana (ngati mukufuna, "bweretsani kiyi yanu"): ma API keys ndi ma tokens a mautumiki a anthu ena omwe mumalumikiza mwakufuna kwanu — mwachitsanzo Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, FAL.ai, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Blotato kapena TikHub. Makiyiwa amasungidwa mobisika ndipo amagwiritsidwa ntchito pokha pokha pochita ntchito zomwe mukupempha.

2.4. Deta ya zomwe zili: mafayilo a media ndi zinthu zomwe mumakweza kapena kupanga pa Nsanja — kuphatikizapo zithunzi zomwe zimagwiritsidwa ntchito popanga ma avatar a zithunzi, zojambulira mawu zomwe zimagwiritsidwa ntchito popanga mawu ofanana, mavidiyo, zolemba, mawu omasulira, zida zamtundu ndi zithunzi zopangidwa — komanso mafunso anu a zochitika, mafotokozedwe a zinthu ndi omvera, mawu osakira, ndi maulalo a mavidiyo a anthu ena omwe mumapereka kuti asanthulidwe.

2.5. Deta yaukadaulo: adilesi ya IP, mtundu wa msakatuli, ma JWT authorisation tokens ndi zolemba za zochitika zofunikira pachitetezo ndi kuthetsa mavuto.

2.6. Deta yapa social media yopezeka pagulu: kuti apereke kusanthula kwa zochitika, Nsanja imapeza zomwe zili pagulu ndi metric za chidwi (mavidiyo, ma channel, chiwerengero cha mawonedwe/zokonda, mawu omasulira) kuchokera ku TikTok, Instagram ndi YouTube kudzera mwa wopereka deta wovomerezeka TikHub. Deta iyi imapezedwa kuchokera ku magwero opezeka pagulu osati kuchokera kwa eni ake a deta; imakonzedwa kokha kuti iwerengere kusanthula kwa zochitika ndi msika ndipo sagwiritsidwa ntchito popanga mbiri kapena kuzindikira anthu omwe akuwonekera muzomwe zili.

Wopereka amakonza deta yaumwini pazifukwa zotsatirazi komanso pamaziko azamalamulo otsatirawa pansi pa Article 6(1) GDPR:

  • Kukwaniritsa mgwirizano (Art. 6(1)(b)): kupanga ndi kusunga akaunti yanu, kupereka zinthu za Nsanja (kupeza zochitika, kusanthula mavidiyo, studio ya mavidiyo ya AI, kukonza ndi kusindikiza), kukonza malipiro a kulembetsa ndi kupereka chithandizo chaukadaulo.
  • Kutsatira malamulo (Art. 6(1)(c)): ntchito zowerengera ndalama, misonkho ndi ma invoice.
  • Zofuna zovomerezeka (Art. 6(1)(f)): kuteteza Nsanja, kupewa chinyengo ndi nkhanza, kusunga kukhazikika kwa ntchito, kusunga metric zamkati zoteteza chinsinsi, ndi kukonza zomwe zili pagulu pa social media kuti zisanthanthule zochitika.
  • Chivomerezo (Art. 6(1)(a)): makeke osafunikira ndi matekinoloje ofanana (onani Ndondomeko ya Makeke) ndi zinthu zilizonse zamtsogolo zomwe zimadalira chivomerezo. Chivomerezo chikhoza kuchotsedwa nthawi iliyonse ndi zotsatira zamtsogolo.

Nsanja sichita zisankho zodziwikiratu zomwe zimabweretsa zotsatira zalamulo kapena zofananira zokhudza inu mkati mwa tanthauzo la Article 22 GDPR.

sections.h: 4. Zithunzi, Mawu ndi Zomwe Zapangidwa ndi AI
sections.b:
4.1. Zithunzi ndi zojambulira mawu zomwe mumakweza zimakonzedwa kokha mukachita zinthu mwadala ndipo kokha kuti mupereke zotsatira zenizeni zomwe mukupempha (mwachitsanzo, chithunzi cha avatar kapena mawu a AI). Sagwiritsidwa ntchito pozindikira ma biometric kapena kugawa ma biometric a munthu aliyense, ndipo sagwiritsidwa ntchito ndi Wopereka pophunzitsa ma artificial intelligence models.

4.2. Pamene kupanga avatar kapena mawu ofanana kumafuna kulembetsa zinthuzo ndi wopereka AI wina (mwachitsanzo HeyGen kapena ElevenLabs), zinthuzo zimatumizidwa kwa woperekayo kokha pa ntchito yopemphedwa ndipo zimakonzedwa pansi pa migwirizano ya woperekayo ndi mapangano okonza deta.

4.3. Mutha kufufuta zinthu zomwe zakwezedwa ndi zinthu zopangidwa mu gallery ya Nsanja nthawi iliyonse. Mukafufuta akaunti yanu, zomwe zili zokhudzana nazo zimachotsedwa, kupatula ngati kusungidwa kumafunika ndi lamulo (onani Gawo 7).

4.4. Muyenera kukhala ndi ufulu wofunikira ndi zivomerezo za munthu aliyense yemwe chithunzi chake kapena mawu ake mumakweza kapena kuwapanga ofanana. Zofunikira zatsatanetsatane zafotokozedwa mu Migwirizano Yogwiritsa Ntchito.

sections.h: 5. Kuulula Zambiri kwa Anthu Ena (Okonza Zinthu Ang'onoang'ono)
sections.b:
Kuti Pulatifomu igwire ntchito, Wopereka Utumiki amagwiritsa ntchito ntchito za anthu ena odalirika omwe angalandire mwayi wopeza zambiri pang'ono pansi pa mapangano okhwima, komanso pokhapokha ngati kuli kofunikira:

  • Zomangamanga ndi kuchereza: Hostinger (ma seva enieni omwe ali ku European Economic Area; nkhokwe za deta ndi code ya pulogalamu).
  • Malipiro: Stripe (malipiro olembetsa, ma invoice, kupewa chinyengo).
  • Nzeru zopangira: Google (mitundu ya Gemini), Anthropic (mitundu ya Claude), OpenAI, FAL.ai, HeyGen (kupanga ma avatar), ElevenLabs (kupanga mawu ndi kukopera mawu) — kudzera mu ma API awo ovomerezeka. Zomwe zili zofunikira pa ntchito inayake yomwe mukuyambitsa zokha ndi zomwe zimatumizidwa.
  • Zambiri za malo ochezera a pa Intaneti: TikHub (kutenga zomwe zikupezeka pagulu komanso miyeso ya pulatifomu).
  • Kusindikiza: Blotato ndi malo ochezera a pa Intaneti omwe mumalumikiza (TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube/Google) — amalandira zomwe mukukonzekera kusindikiza komanso zidziwitso zomwe mwalumikiza mu maakaunti anu.
  • Kutsimikizira: Google (posankha "Lowani ndi Google").

Ngati mulumikiza kiyi yanu ya API kapena kulembetsa kwa ntchito ya munthu wina, ntchitoyo imakonza zambiri zanu pansi pa mgwirizano wanu ndi iyo; Wopereka Utumiki amangotumiza zopempha zanu m'malo mwanu.

Wopereka Utumiki sagulitsa zambiri zaumwini ndipo sazizigwiritsa ntchito potsatsa kapena kutsatsa kwa anthu ena.

6.1. Nkhokwe za deta za Pulatifomu komanso code ya pulogalamu zimachitidwa pa ma seva omwe ali mkati mwa European Economic Area (EEA).

6.2. Ena mwa opereka utumiki omwe atchulidwa mu Gawo 5 (mwachitsanzo Stripe, Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, FAL.ai, Blotato) ali ku United States kapena mayiko ena achitatu. Kutumiza kwa opereka utumiki oterowo kumachitika potengera chisankho chokwanira cha European Commission (kuphatikiza EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, ngati wopereka utumiki ali ndi satifiketi) kapena potengera European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (Art. 46(2)(c) GDPR) ndi njira zowonjezera ngati pakufunika.

6.3. Kopi ya zoteteza zofunikira ikhoza kupemphedwa kudzera pa imelo yolumikizirana yomwe yasonyezedwa mu Gawo 1.

• Zambiri za akaunti: kwa nthawi yonse yolembetsa kapena ntchito ya akaunti. Akaunti ikachotsedwa, zambiri zimafafanizidwa, kupatula zambiri zomwe ziyenera kusungidwa kuti zigwirizane ndi malamulo a misonkho ndi ma accounting (mpaka zaka 5).
  • Zambiri za zomwe zili (media, analyses, mavidiyo opangidwa): mpaka mutazichotsa kudzera pa Pulatifomu kapena kutseka akaunti yanu.
  • Makiyi ophatikizira (BYOK): mpaka mutawachotsa muzokonda kapena kutseka akaunti yanu; amasungidwa mobisa kwa nthawi yonse.
  • Zolemba zaukadaulo: monga lamulo, osapitirira miyezi 12, pokhapokha ngati nthawi yayitali ikufunika kuti afufuze zochitika zachitetezo kapena ndi lamulo.
  • Zolemba za malipiro: kwa nthawi yofunikira ndi lamulo la misonkho.

8.1. Wopereka Utumiki amagwiritsa ntchito njira zaukadaulo ndi zokonzekera zamakono: kutumiza zambiri mobisa (HTTPS/TLS), kusungitsa mapasiwedi, kubisa makiyi a API osungidwa, chitetezo cha magawo chotengera JWT, kuwongolera mwayi wopeza komanso mfundo yocheperako ya mwayi wopeza.

8.2. Mwayi wopeza zambiri zaumwini umangokhala kwa anthu omwe akuzifuna kuti agwiritse ntchito Pulatifomu komanso omwe ali ndi udindo wosunga chinsinsi.

8.3. Pakachitika kuphwanya kwa zambiri zaumwini komwe kungayambitse chiopsezo ku ufulu wanu ndi ufulu wanu, Wopereka Utumiki adzadziwitsa akuluakulu oyang'anira oyenerera komanso, ngati pakufunika ndi Article 34 GDPR, Ogwiritsa Ntchito omwe akhudzidwa.

Muli ndi ufulu woti:

  • pemphani mwayi wopeza zambiri zanu zaumwini ndikupeza kopi yake;
  • pemphani kukonza zambiri zolakwika kapena zosakwanira;
  • pemphani kufafaniza zambiri ("ufulu woiwalika") ngati palibe chifukwa chalamulo chosungira;

  • kutsutsa kukonza kutengera zofuna zovomerezeka, pazifukwa zokhudzana ndi momwe mulili;
  • chotsani chilolezo nthawi iliyonse, osakhudza kuvomerezeka kwa kukonza komwe kunachitika chilolezo chisanachotsedwe.

Kuti mugwiritse ntchito ufulu umenewu, tumizani pempho ku SEO@trendtraffic.pro. Wopereka Utumiki amayankha mkati mwa mwezi umodzi (wokhoza kuwonjezeredwa ndi miyezi iwiri yowonjezera pazopempha zovuta, ndi chidziwitso).

sections.h: 10. Nzeru Zopangapanga ndi Lamulo (EU) 2024/1689 (Lamulo la EU AI)
sections.b:
10.1. Pulatifomu imagwirizanitsa mitundu ya AI yopezeka pagulu yochokera kwa opereka chithandizo ena kudzera mu ma API awo ovomerezeka (Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, FAL.ai) pofufuza zochitika, kupanga zolemba ndi mawu ofunika, kumasulira, kusanthula makanema chimango ndi chimango, kupanga zithunzi za anthu komanso kupanga mawu. Wopereka chithandizo sapanga kapena kuphunzitsa mitundu yake ya AI ndipo si wopereka mitundu ya AI yofala monga tanthauzo la Lamulo (EU) 2024/1689 ("Lamulo la EU AI").

10.2. Kugwiritsa ntchito AI pa Pulatifomu kumagwera m'magulu ochepa kwambiri komanso ochepa chiwopsezo a Lamulo la EU AI. Pulatifomu sigwiritsa ntchito machitidwe a AI okhala ndi chiwopsezo chachikulu monga tanthauzo la Annex III ya Lamuloli.

10.3. Kuonekera kwa zomwe zapangidwa ndi AI: Pulatifomu ndi chida chopangira makanema, mawu ndi zithunzi zopangidwa ndi AI komanso zosinthidwa ndi AI (kuphatikiza zithunzi za anthu ndi mawu opangidwa). Zinthu za AI zimasonyezedwa bwino pa mawonekedwe. Ngati opereka chithandizo a AI amayika zizindikiro zowerengeka ndi makina kapena zizindikiro zamadzi muzomwe zapangidwa (Ndime 50(2) ya Lamulo la EU AI), Pulatifomu imazisunga ndipo sizichotsa. Ogwiritsa ntchito amakakamizidwa ndi mgwirizano kuti awulule ma deep fake ndi zina zopangidwa ndi AI monga momwe zimafunikira ndi Ndime 50(4) ya Lamulo la EU AI komanso ndi malamulo a malo ochezera a pa Intaneti kumene amafalitsa (onani Migwirizano Yogwiritsa Ntchito).

10.4. Machitidwe oletsedwa ndi Ndime 5 ya Lamulo la EU AI — kusokoneza mwachinsinsi, kugwiritsa ntchito zofooka (kuphatikiza za ana), kuwerengera anthu, kuwerengera koyambirira kwa milandu ya anthu, kukolopa zithunzi za nkhope mosasankha kuchokera pa intaneti kapena CCTV, kuzindikira malingaliro kuntchito komanso m'maphunziro, kugawa anthu mwachilengedwe kutengera mikhalidwe yovuta, komanso kuzindikira anthu mwachilengedwe nthawi yeniyeni m'malo opezeka pagulu — siziperekedwa ndi Pulatifomu, zikuletsedwa ndi Migwirizano Yogwiritsa Ntchito, ndipo zopempha zokhudzana ndi machitidwewa zimakanidwa.

10.5. Kuyang'anira kwa anthu: Zotsatira za AI (kusanthula, zolemba, mawu ofunika, makanema opangidwa) ndi zolemba zoyambirira zomwe zitha kukhala ndi zolakwika. Ogwiritsa ntchito amawunika ndikuvomereza zomwe zili musanagwiritse ntchito kapena kufalitsa.

Pulatifomu ndi chida chaukadaulo choyenera kwa anthu azaka zosachepera 18. Wopereka chithandizo sadziwa kusonkhanitsa zidziwitso zaumwini za ana. Ngati mukukhulupirira kuti mwana wapereka zidziwitso zaumwini ku Pulatifomu, chonde lemberani SEO@trendtraffic.pro ndipo zidziwitsozo zidzachotsedwa.

Wopereka chithandizo akhoza kusintha Ndondomeko iyi, makamaka kuti asonyeze kusintha kwa malamulo kapena magwiridwe antchito a Pulatifomu. Mtundu wamakono umasindikizidwa nthawi zonse pa Pulatifomu, ndi tsiku la "kusinthidwa komaliza" pamwamba. Pakakhala zosintha zazikulu, Ogwiritsa ntchito adzadziwitsidwanso kudzera pa imelo kapena mu pulogalamu.

5.4. Wopereka akhoza kusintha mitengo yolembetsa. Kusintha kwa mitengo kumalengezedwa masiku osachepera 14 pasadakhale ndipo kumagwira ntchito kuyambira nthawi yotsatira yolipira; ngati simukuvomereza, mutha kuthetsa mtengo watsopano usanayambe kugwira ntchito.

5.5. Ndalama za anthu ena sizikuphatikizidwa mu kulembetsa: ndalama za makiyi a API a Wogwiritsa Ntchito ndi zolembetsa (mwachitsanzo, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, FAL.ai, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Blotato, TikHub), ma komishoni a opereka malipiro ndi mitengo ya ma social network amalipidwa ndi Wogwiritsa Ntchito mwachindunji kwa operekawo malinga ndi mawu awo.

6.1. Pulatifomu imapereka mwayi wathunthu wopeza zinthu za digito ndi zida zowerengera (kuphatikiza mtengo wosinthira zopempha za AI) nthawi yomweyo malipiro akapambana.

6.2. Ogwiritsa ntchito ku EU — kusiya ufulu wochotsa: malinga ndi Directive 2011/83/EU ndi Polish Act ya 30 May 2014 pa Ufulu wa Ogwiritsa Ntchito (makamaka zomwe zikukhudza kupereka zinthu za digito ndi ntchito za digito), poyambitsa kulembetsa kolipidwa wogwiritsa ntchito akufunsa momveka bwino ndikuvomereza kuti ntchito iyambe nthawi yomweyo, nthawi yochotsa masiku 14 isanathe, ndipo akuvomereza kuti akusowa ufulu wochotsa kuyambira nthawi yomwe ntchito ikupezeka mokwanira. Kuvomereza ndi kuvomereza kumeneku kumasonkhanitsidwanso panthawi yolipira.

6.3. Chifukwa chake, malipiro ndi omaliza ndipo salipiridwa, kuphatikiza ngati Wogwiritsa Ntchito athetsa kulembetsa nthawi yolipira isanathe (mwayi umapitilira mpaka kumapeto kwa nthawiyo). Kuyesa kwaulere kwa masiku 7 (Gawo 4) kumaperekedwa ndendende kuti ntchito ikhoza kuwunikidwa mokwanira malipiro asanaperekedwe.

6.4. Ndime 6.1–6.3 sizichotsa kapena kuchepetsa ufulu uliwonse womwe lamulo lokakamiza limapereka kwa ogwiritsa ntchito ndipo silingathe kusiidwa, kuphatikiza njira zalamulo zosagwirizana ndi zinthu za digito ndi ntchito za digito (Directive (EU) 2019/770 ndi kukhazikitsidwa kwake ku Poland). Kumene malamulo okakamiza oterowo akugwira ntchito, amaposa Gawo ili.

6.5. Kwa Ogwiritsa Ntchito omwe si ogwiritsa ntchito (ogwiritsa ntchito mabizinesi), ndalama zonse ndi zomaliza ndipo salipiridwa mpaka pamlingo waukulu womwe lamulo limalola.

sections.h: 7. BYOK Integrations, Chrome Extension ndi MCP
sections.b:
7.1. Pulatifomu imalola Wogwiritsa ntchito kulumikiza makiyi awo a API ndi zolembetsa za mautumiki a anthu ena ("BYOK") — mwachitsanzo Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, FAL.ai, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Blotato kapena TikHub. Mautumiki oterewa amagwiritsidwa ntchito malinga ndi mapangano a Wogwiritsa ntchito ndi opereka mautumikiwo; Wogwiritsa ntchito amanyamula ndalama zogwirizana ndi izi ndipo ali ndi udindo wotsatira malamulo a opereka mautumikiwo.

7.2. TrendTraffic Chrome extension imalumikiza zinthu zina (mwachitsanzo HeyGen, Google Flow, NotebookLM) kudzera mu maakaunti ndi zolembetsa za Wogwiritsa ntchito mu msakatuli wa Wogwiritsa ntchito. Wogwiritsa ntchito ali ndi udindo wogwiritsa ntchito maakauntiwo molingana ndi malamulo a mautumikiwo; Wopereka utumiki sagwirizana kuti extension idzagwira ntchito mosadodometsedwa ndi ma interface a anthu ena ndipo akhoza kusintha kapena kusiya kugwiritsa ntchito zolumikizira zina ngati munthu wina asintha malamulo ake kapena ukadaulo wake.

7.3. Makiyi a API operekedwa ndi Wogwiritsa ntchito amasungidwa mobisa ndipo amagwiritsidwa ntchito pokha pokwaniritsa ntchito zomwe Wogwiritsa ntchito wapempha. Wogwiritsa ntchito akhoza kuwachotsa nthawi iliyonse mu zoikamo.

7.4. Kiyi yaumwini ya MCP imalola othandizira a AI (mwachitsanzo Claude) kupeza akaunti ya Wogwiritsa ntchito. Wogwiritsa ntchito ali ndi udindo wosunga kiyiwo mwachinsinsi komanso pazochita zonse zomwe zachitika ndi kiyiwo, ndipo akhoza kuichotsa nthawi iliyonse.

8.1. Wogwiritsa ntchito akugwirizana kuti sadzagwiritsa ntchito Pulatifomu pa:

  • ntchito iliyonse yosaloledwa, spam, phishing kapena mtundu uliwonse wa chinyengo;
  • kupanga, kusanthula kapena kufalitsa zinthu zomwe ndi zosaloledwa, zonyoza, zovutitsa, kapena zomwe zikuphwanya ufulu wa katundu wanzeru, ufulu wachinsinsi kapena ufulu wofalitsa wa anthu ena;
  • kupanga kapena kugwiritsa ntchito chithunzi kapena mawu a munthu weniweni popanda ufulu wofunikira kapena chilolezo cha munthuyo, kuphatikizapo kudziyesa munthu weniweni;
  • kupanga zinthu zogonana, zapamtima kapena zochitira nkhanza zomwe zikuwonetsa anthu enieni osadziwika popanda chilolezo chawo chachindunji, kapena zinthu zilizonse zoterezi zokhudza ana (zomwe ndizoletsedwa kwambiri ndipo zidzaperekedwa kwa akuluakulu oyenerera);
  • kupanga zinthu zonyenga zomwe cholinga chake ndi kusokeretsa anthu, kuphatikizapo zabodza zokhudza zisankho, thanzi la anthu kapena chitetezo;
  • kuphwanya malamulo ogwiritsira ntchito a anthu ena ophatikizidwa (makamaka TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube/Google, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Blotato, Stripe), kuphatikizapo malamulo awo okhudza zinthu zopangidwa ndi makina ndi kufalitsa kokha;
  • kuyesa kusokoneza, kulemetsa, kusintha kapena kupeza mwayi wosaloledwa ku Pulatifomu;
  • kugwiritsa ntchito zinthu za AI motsutsana ndi Ndime 5 ya Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (EU AI Act), kuphatikizapo: kusokoneza mwachinsinsi; kugwiritsa ntchito zofooka za ana kapena magulu osatetezeka; kuwerengera anthu; kuwerengera koyambirira kwa milandu ya anthu; kukoka zithunzi za nkhope mosasankha kuchokera pa intaneti kapena CCTV; kuzindikira malingaliro a antchito kapena ophunzira; kugawa anthu mwa biometric kutengera zinthu zovuta; kapena kuzindikira munthu mwa biometric patali nthawi yeniyeni m'malo opezeka anthu ambiri.

8.2. Pokweza chithunzi kapena kujambula mawu, Wogwiritsa ntchito akuyimira ndipo akugwirizana kuti ndi munthu wojambulidwa/wojambulidwa kapena ali ndi chilolezo chachindunji, chidziwitso cha munthuyo (ndipo, pazinthu zomwe zili ndi ufulu wa copyright, ziphaso zofunikira).

8.3. Pakachitika kuphwanya, Wopereka utumiki akhoza kuchotsa zinthu zophwanya malamulo ndikuyimitsa kapena kuthetsa akaunti ya Wogwiritsa ntchito popanda kubweza ndalama (Ndime 13), popanda kusokoneza njira zina zalamulo.

sections.h: 9. Zinthu za AI, Zinthu Zopangidwa ndi Makina ndi Kuwonekera Poyera
sections.b:
9.1. Zinthu za AI za Pulatifomu zimagwira ntchito pa zitsanzo zopezeka poyera za opereka mautumiki a anthu ena (Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, FAL.ai) zomwe zimayambitsidwa kudzera mu ma API ovomerezeka. Zambiri za kukonza deta zafotokozedwa mu Privacy Policy.

9.2. Zinthu zopangidwa ndi AI (kusanthula, zolemba, mawu ofunikira, mawu, mavidiyo) zikhoza kukhala ndi zolakwika kapena zosalongosoka ndipo sizipereka uphungu waukadaulo, wazamalamulo, wazachipatala kapena wazachuma. Wogwiritsa ntchito ayenera kuwunika zinthu zopangidwa asanagwiritse ntchito kapena kufalitsa ndipo ali ndi udindo wonse pa kugwiritsa ntchito kwake.

9.3. Kuwulula zinthu zopangidwa ndi makina: pamene Wogwiritsa ntchito apanga kapena kusintha chithunzi, mawu kapena vidiyo yomwe ikufanana kwambiri ndi anthu, zinthu, malo kapena zochitika zomwe zilipo kale ndipo zikhoza kuwoneka ngati zenizeni kapena zoona kwa munthu (a "deep fake"), Wogwiritsa ntchito ayenera kuwulula momveka bwino kuti zinthuzo zapangidwa kapena kusinthidwa mwachinyengo, molingana ndi Ndime 50(4) ya EU AI Act ndi malamulo a malo ochezera a pa Intaneti kumene zinthuzo zafalitsidwa. Pamene opereka mautumiki a AI a anthu ena amayika zizindikiro zowerengedwa ndi makina kapena ma watermark mu zinthu zopangidwa, Wogwiritsa ntchito sayenera kuzichotsa kapena kuzibisa.

9.4. Wopereka utumiki sagwirizana kuti zinthu zopangidwa ndi AI zilibe ufulu wa anthu ena (mwachitsanzo pamene zolowetsa za Wogwiritsa ntchito zili ndi zinthu zotetezedwa) ndipo sagwirizana ndi zotsatira zilizonse zamalonda (mawonedwe, kufikira, kupeza ndalama).

sections.h: 10. Zinthu Zoyika ndi Katundu Wanzeru wa Ogwiritsa Ntchito
sections.b:
10.1. Wogwiritsa ntchito amasunga ufulu wonse pa zinthu zomwe amayika. Wogwiritsa ntchito amapatsa Wopereka chilolezo chosakhala chapadera, chapadziko lonse lapansi chosungira, kukonza, kusintha ndi kutumiza zinthu zotere pokhapokha ngati kuli kofunikira kuti apereke ntchito za Platform (kuphatikizapo kutumiza kwa opereka AI ndi malo ochezera a pa Intaneti osankhidwa ndi Wogwiritsa ntchito). Chilolezo chimatha pamene zomwe zili kapena akaunti yachotsedwa, kupatula makope ofunikira ndi lamulo.

10.2. Pakati pa Wopereka ndi Wogwiritsa ntchito, Wopereka sakhala ndi ufulu pa zotsatira zopangidwira Wogwiritsa ntchito. Ufulu wa Wogwiritsa ntchito pa zotsatira zopangidwa ndi AI umatsimikiziridwa ndi lamulo loyenera komanso ndi mawu a opereka AI achitatu omwe akukhudzidwa; Wogwiritsa ntchito ali ndi udindo wotsimikizira kuti ntchito yake yomwe akufuna ikuloledwa.

10.3. Mapulogalamu a Platform, mapangidwe, zizindikiro ndi nkhokwe za deta zimakhalabe za Wopereka kapena opereka chilolezo chake. Mawu awa sapereka ufulu uliwonse pa izo kupatula ufulu wogwiritsa ntchito Platform monga momwe akufunira.

10.4. Zomwe zili za anthu ena zomwe zikuwonetsedwa pakusanthula kwazinthu (mavidiyo, zikuto, miyezo ya TikTok/Instagram/YouTube) zimakhalabe za eni ake ndi mapulatifomu; zikuwonetsedwa kuti zisanthule msika. Kugwiritsa ntchito kwina kulikonse kwa zomwe zili zotere ndi Wogwiritsa ntchito (mwachitsanzo, kuyikanso vidiyo ya wina) kumafuna maziko ake ovomerezeka a Wogwiritsa ntchito.

sections.h: 11. Chitetezo cha Deta; Kukonza m'malo mwa Wogwiritsa Ntchito
sections.b:
11.1. Kukonza deta yaumwini ya Ogwiritsa Ntchito kumafotokozedwa mu Ndondomeko Yachinsinsi.

11.2. Ngati zinthu zomwe Wogwiritsa ntchito amayika kapena kukonza pa Platform zili ndi deta yaumwini ya anthu ena (mwachitsanzo, chithunzi kapena mawu a wofotokozera, ndemanga za makasitomala), Wogwiritsa ntchito amakhala Woyang'anira Deta wa deta yotere ndipo Wopereka amakonza ngati Wokonza mkati mwa tanthauzo la Article 28 GDPR — kokha pa malangizo olembedwa a Wogwiritsa ntchito omwe afotokozedwa pogwiritsa ntchito zinthu za Platform, ndipo kokha kuti apereke ntchitoyo.

11.3. Wopereka amagwiritsa ntchito njira zoyenera zaukadaulo ndi bungwe zachitetezo, amangogwiritsa ntchito okonza ang'onoang'ono omwe ali mu Ndondomeko Yachinsinsi (Wogwiritsa ntchito amavomereza kugwiritsa ntchito kwawo; kusintha kwakukulu kudzatsimikiziridwa), amathandiza Wogwiritsa ntchito moyenera ndi zopempha za eni deta, ndipo amachotsa kapena kubweza deta kumapeto kwa ntchitoyo molingana ndi malamulo osungira a Ndondomeko Yachinsinsi.

sections.h: 12. Kukanidwa kwa Zitsimikizo ndi Kuchepetsa Udindo
sections.b:
12.1. "Monga momwe zilili": Platform imaperekedwa "monga momwe zilili" komanso "monga momwe zilipo". Mpaka pamene lamulo likuloledwa, Wopereka satsimikizira kuti Platform idzagwira ntchito popanda kusokonezeka kapena zolakwika kapena kuti idzakwaniritsa zoyembekeza za Wogwiritsa ntchito.

12.2. Kudalira anthu ena: ntchito za Platform zimadalira kwambiri opereka achitatu. Wopereka sakhala ndi udindo pa: kusokonezeka, kusintha kwa malamulo kapena malire a ma API ndi ntchito za TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube/Google, TikHub, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Google (Gemini, Flow, NotebookLM), Anthropic, OpenAI, FAL.ai, Blotato kapena Stripe; pa zisankho zoyendetsa za malo ochezera a pa Intaneti okhudzana ndi zomwe Wogwiritsa ntchito adasindikiza; kapena pa zovuta zomwe zimachitika chifukwa cha opereka hosting.

12.3. Mpaka pamene lamulo likuloledwa, Wopereka sakhala ndi udindo pa zowonongeka zosapita mwachindunji, phindu lotayika, kutayika kwa deta kapena kutayika kwa makasitomala chifukwa chogwiritsa ntchito, kapena kulephera kugwiritsa ntchito, Platform.

12.4. Udindo waukulu wa Wopereka kwa Wogwiritsa ntchito pa zonena zonse umachepetsedwa ku ndalama zomwe Wogwiritsa ntchito adalipira pa ntchito za Platform mwezi watha woyambira chaka chisanachitike chochitika chomwe chidayambitsa zonena.

12.5. Zochepetsa mu Gawo ili sizikugwira ntchito pa udindo wa khalidwe loipa kapena kusasamala kwakukulu, pa imfa kapena kuvulala kwaumwini, kapena muzochitika zina zilizonse zomwe udindo sungathe kuchepetsedwa pansi pa lamulo lokakamiza. Kwa ogula, njira zalamulo zosakwanira za ntchito za digito zimakhalabe zosakhudzidwa (Gawo 6.4).

13.1. Wogwiritsa ntchito akhoza kusiya kugwiritsa ntchito Platform ndikuchotsa akaunti nthawi iliyonse; Gawo 6 likugwira ntchito pa malipiro omwe apangidwa kale.

13.2. Wopereka akhoza kuyimitsa kapena kuthetsa akaunti, kuchotsa zomwe zili ndikukana ntchito — popanda kubweza ndalama zomwe zalipidwa kale — ngati pali kuphwanya kwakukulu kwa Mawu awa (makamaka Gawo 8), ngati kofunikira ndi lamulo kapena ndi lamulo la akuluakulu oyenerera, kapena ngati pali chiwopsezo chachikulu chachitetezo. Ngati kuli koyenera, Wopereka adzapereka chidziwitso choyamba ndikukhazikitsa nthawi yoti akonze kuphwanyako; kwa ogula, ufulu walamulo wokhudzana ndi nthawi yolipidwa umakhalabe wosakhudzidwa ngati kuthetsa sikuchitika chifukwa cha kuphwanya kwa wogula.

13.3. Magawo 6, 10, 12 ndi 15 amakhalabe ogwira ntchito pambuyo pa kuthetsa.

14.1. Wopereka akhoza kusintha Mawu awa pazifukwa zomveka: kusintha kwa lamulo, zinthu zatsopano, zofunikira zachitetezo kapena kusintha kwa ntchito za anthu ena ophatikizidwa.

14.2. Ogwiritsa ntchito adzadziwitsidwa za kusintha kwakukulu masiku osachepera 14 asanayambe kugwira ntchito, kudzera pa imelo kapena mu pulogalamu. Ngati Wogwiritsa ntchito sakuvomereza, akhoza kuthetsa kulembetsa asanayambe kugwira ntchito; kupitiriza kugwiritsa ntchito pambuyo pa tsikulo kumatanthauza kuvomereza.

15.1. Migwirizano iyi ikulamulidwa ndi malamulo a Republic of Poland. Ngati Wogwiritsa Ntchito ndi kasitomala, kusankha kumeneku kwa lamulo sikumamulepheretsa chitetezo choperekedwa ndi malamulo okakamiza a dziko kumene amakhala (Ndime 6(2) ya Regulation (EC) No 593/2008, "Rome I").

15.2. Kwa ogwiritsa ntchito mabizinesi, mikangano imayang'aniridwa ndi khoti loyenera la ofesi yolembetsedwa ya Wopereka Chithandizo (Warsaw, Poland). Kwa makasitomala, ulamuliro umatsimikiziridwa ndi malamulo oyenera.

15.3. cookies.metaDescription: Ndi ma cookie ati ndi zolemba za localStorage zomwe TrendTraffic amagwiritsa ntchito, pazifukwa ziti komanso kwa nthawi yayitali bwanji, omwe ndi anthu ena omwe amakhazikitsa ma cookie (Stripe, Google sign-in), komanso momwe mungaperekere, kukana kapena kusintha chilolezo chanu.

sections.h: 1. Ma Cookie ndi Matekinoloje Ofanana Ndi Chiyani
sections.b:
1.1. Ma cookie ndi mafayilo ang'onoang'ono a mawu osungidwa pa chipangizo chanu mukayendera tsamba la webusayiti, kulola tsambalo kuzindikira chipangizo chanu ndikukumbukira zomwe mumakonda.

1.2. Kuphatikiza pa ma cookie, pulatifomu ya TrendTraffic imagwiritsa ntchito Local Storage ya msakatuli — mwa zina, kusunga chizindikiro chovomerezeka cha gawo lanu, chilankhulo chanu ndi mutu wa mawonekedwe, komanso kusankha kwanu kwa chilolezo cha cookie. Ndondomeko iyi imagwira ntchito kwa ma cookie ndi Local Storage mofanana.

2.1. Ofunika kwambiri (aukadaulo) — ofunikira kuti Pulatifomu igwire ntchito; amagwiritsidwa ntchito potengera chidwi chovomerezeka cha Wopereka Chithandizo ndipo safuna chilolezo:

  • vibevox_token — chizindikiro chovomerezeka cha JWT cha gawo lanu (Local Storage; mpaka kutuluka kapena kutha kwa chizindikiro);
  • vibevox_user — cache ya mbiri ya wogwiritsa ntchito wolowa (Local Storage; mpaka kutuluka);
  • tt_cookie_consent — imasunga kusankha kwanu kwa chilolezo cha cookie (Local Storage; mpaka mutasintha kapena kuchotsa).

2.2. Ogwira ntchito (zomwe mumakonda):

  • i18nextLng — chilankhulo chosankhidwa cha mawonekedwe (Local Storage; mpaka chitasinthidwa kapena kuchotsedwa);
  • vibevox_theme — mutu wowala/wakuda (Local Storage; mpaka chitasinthidwa kapena kuchotsedwa).

Pazifukwa zakale, zizindikiro zina zimakhala ndi chiyambi cha "vibevox" cha mzere woyambirira wa zinthu za Wopereka Chithandizo; zimakhala za pulatifomu ya TrendTraffic.

2.3. Kusanthula: Pulatifomu pakadali pano ikukhazikitsa palibe zotsatira za kusanthula kapena kutsatsa kwa anthu ena. Zoyambira, zoyezera ntchito zoteteza zinsinsi zimasonkhanitsidwa kumbali ya seva popanda kutsatira mawebusayiti osiyanasiyana. Ngati kusanthula kotengera chilolezo kuyambitsidwa, kumangoyamba mutasankha "Landirani zonse".

2.4. Ma cookie a anthu ena: ntchito zakunja zophatikizidwa mu Pulatifomu zitha kukhazikitsa ma cookie awo mukamagwiritsa ntchito:

  • Stripe — chitetezo cha malipiro ndi kupewa chinyengo pamasamba olipira ndi owerengera (mwachitsanzo __stripe_mid, ~chaka chimodzi; __stripe_sid, ~maminitsi 30);
  • Google — mukamagwiritsa ntchito "Lowani ndi Google", Google imakhazikitsa ma cookie pansi pa ndondomeko yakeyake;
  • Ma social network olumikizidwa (TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube) — mkati mwa mawonekedwe awo okha mukalumikiza kapena kuwatsegula.

• Kuvomerezeka ndi chitetezo cha gawo la Wogwiritsa Ntchito.
  • Chitetezo cha malipiro.
  • Kukumbukira chilankhulo, mutu ndi kusankha kwanu kwa chilolezo.
  • Kutsimikizira kukhazikika ndi magwiridwe antchito a ntchitoyi.

4.1. Mukayendera koyamba, Pulatifomu imawonetsa chizindikiro chovomerezeka molingana ndi Ndime 399 ya Polish Electronic Communications Law (Prawo komunikacji elektronicznej), GDPR ndi ePrivacy Directive (2002/58/EC). Mutha kusankha "Landirani zonse" kapena "Zofunikira zokha" — zosankha zonse ziwiri ndizosavuta kuzipeza, ndipo palibe matekinoloje osafunikira omwe amayatsidwa musanasankhe.

4.2. Mutha kusintha kusankha kwanu nthawi iliyonse — gwiritsani ntchito ulalo wa "Zokonda za Cookie" pansi pa tsamba kapena batani pansi pa Ndondomeko iyi; chizindikirocho chidzatsegulidwanso.

4.3. Masakatuli ambiri amakulolani kuti mutseke kapena kuchotsa ma cookie ndi Local Storage muzokonda zawo (Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Safari, Microsoft Edge). Dziwani: ngati zolemba zofunikira kwambiri zatsekedwa kapena kuchotsedwa kwathunthu, kulowa ndi kugwiritsa ntchito Pulatifomu kudzakhala kosatheka.

• Zambiri za gawo: zimachotsedwa mukatuluka kapena chizindikiro chovomerezeka chikatha.
  • Zomwe mumakonda (chilankhulo, mutu, kusankha kwa chilolezo): zimasungidwa mpaka mutazisintha kapena kuchotsa zambiri za msakatuli wanu; kusankha kwa chilolezo kumatsitsimutsidwa osachepera miyezi 12 iliyonse pobwezeretsanso chizindikirocho ngati pakufunika.
  • Ma cookie a anthu ena: molingana ndi ndondomeko ya wopereka chithandizo (onani Gawo 2.4).
